{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|I'm glad to see that my handmaidens are so well trained.|Queen Amidala|<ref name="QID">''[[Queen in Disguise]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ElleMotee-OP.png|thumb|220px|[[Ellé/Legends|Ellé]] and [[Moteé/Legends|Moteé]]]]
The '''Naboo Royal Handmaidens''' were the [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] who served the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]]. 

==Description==
The handmaidens cultivated an air of being harmless and demure, and publicly were stated to be the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] companions, counsel, and aides who assisted her with managing her [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|extensive collection of gowns]]. In truth, each handmaiden was a member of the [[Order of Sanctuary]], a secret society who had volunteered their service to protect the Queen. Each handmaiden was a highly-trained [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] who also acted as a decoy if needed, and each wielded a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] that had been specifically created for them.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==History==
A [[Queen/Legends|queen]] who reigned long before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] began the custom for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchs]] to have an entourage of handmaidens to ensure their safety.<ref name="FF 4">{{FactFile2014|4|AMI 1-4|Padmé Amidala}}</ref> The handmaidens were drawn from the Order of Sanctuary, a secret society of warriors that had pledged their service to the queen.<ref name="RPG-Core" /> During the reign of Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the handmaidens bore a striking resemblance to their mistress. They were highly trained in order to act as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], decoys, and confidantes to the queen,<ref name="TCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> roles devised by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]].<ref name="QID" /> Queens [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and [[Kylantha]] were also known to employ handmaidens.<ref name="Threat of the Conqueror">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Royal Handmaiden}}</ref>

As queen, Amidala's handmaidens were [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], [[Eirtaé/Legends|Eirtaé]], [[Rabé/Legends|Rabé]], [[Saché/Legends|Saché]], [[Yané/Legends|Yané]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Fé]],<ref name="DB: Fé">{{DB|character|fe|Fé}}</ref> and [[Dané]].<ref name="Invasion of Theed">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]]</ref> After she became a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], her handmaidens were [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé]], [[Dormé/Legends|Dormé]], [[Versé/Legends|Versé]],<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]],<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> [[Moteé/Legends|Moteé]],<ref name="DB: Moteé">{{DB|character|motee|Moteé}}</ref> and [[Ellé/Legends|Ellé]],<ref name="DB: Ellé">{{DB|character|elle|Ellé}}</ref> with Sabé and Eirtaé serving again.<ref name="In Triplicate">{{TCWComicCite|6.3|In Triplicate}}</ref> Other handmaidens of Amidala included [[Hollé/Legends|Hollé]], [[Miré/Legends|Miré]], and [[Umé/Legends|Umé]].<ref name="LTTQ">{{InsiderCite|142|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Loyal to their Queen!}}</ref> Queen Kylantha's handmaidens included [[Altah]]<ref name="SWG:TE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|The Emperor|Naboo}}</ref> and [[Jaanie]].<ref name="SWG:BN">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Boss Nass|Naboo}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Royal_Handmaidens.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Two of Kylantha's handmaidens]]
Originally and according to the obsolete [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]], Teckla Minnau survived the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and returned to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where she eventually [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Teckla Minnau's spouse|writer]] and became a handmaiden to Queen Kylantha.<ref name="DB: Teckla">{{DB|character|teckla|Minnau, Teckla}}</ref> However, her fate was changed in [[2014]] by "[[An Old Friend]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which established that she [[Death/Legends|died]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]].<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref>
